references.text: Jesus' knowledge of what was to happen is also emphasized here, where he knows who does not believe and who will betray him.
Jesus' complete knowledge of his fate and what he was about to do is a central theme in the passion narrative.
Jesus takes the initiative and knows what is going to happen, just as in John 6:6 where he knows what he is about to do.
Jesus completes his work by knowing that everything has been accomplished, which reflects his knowledge of the future in John 6:6.
Jesus knows beforehand who will betray him, a direct parallel to his knowledge of what he himself is about to do.
Jesus foresees what will happen to him, which underscores his overview of his own fate.
